name: CYCLETRACK 骑迹 Phantom 魅影 / L-TWOO RX 24-speed
why_interesting: Current manufacturer and mainland indexes establish Phantom / 魅影 as the model and L-TWOO RX 24-speed as the drivetrain; RX is not a model suffix.

facts.frame_material: Carbon frame and carbon fork; the exact current RX 24-speed page does not publish a fiber grade, and conflicting T700, T800 and T1000 claims from other Phantom generations or trims are not assigned
facts.frame_construction: Aero road frame with fully internal cable routing and hydraulic flat-mount disc brakes
facts.drivetrain: L-TWOO RX mechanical 2x12 / 24-speed with hydraulic disc brakes, SENICX PR1 50/34 crank, ATA cassette and KMC chain
facts.reference_builds: The exact official alloy-rim reference build is listed around 8.5 kg; a separate Shimano 105 alloy-wheel build was independently reported at 8.7 kg
facts.stiffness_evidence: No exact-model numeric stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent frame-stiffness assessment was found across the 50-area sweep

missing: Selected wheel option and complete weight with size, pedals and measurement method
Maximum tire clearance and exact carbon grade for the retained RX option
Meaningful exact-model stiffness evidence, exact domestic warranty route, seller authority and final checkout price
source_note: The exact official RX 24-speed page lists an alloy-rim reference build around 8.5 kg, while current JD indexes expose both alloy- and carbon-wheel options. The retained price observation does not reveal its selected wheel option, so complete weight remains unassigned. Fitted 25C tires are not treated as maximum clearance.
